name: coffer-extension
description: Browser extension for securely filling Coffer TOTP codes.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --self-hosted --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md PRIVACY.md LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs .github .git .gitignore node_modules dist web-ext-artifacts scripts
scripts.package:firefox: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md PRIVACY.md LICENSE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md docs .github .git .gitignore node_modules dist web-ext-artifacts scripts
scripts.package:all: npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
